india_website_legal_matrix.authority: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025, applied by commencement date.

india_website_legal_matrix.gap: Confirm launch date, provider regions/access, controller/contact facts, actual analytics enablement, retention, and publish an accurate policy/notice.
